title: Qualify exact expression NuGet dependency on published dw.quantities with independent package-only binary consumer
commitMessage: test: qualify exact NuGet Expression candidate with published base

contribution.summary: Qualify a new dw.quantities.expression calendar NuGet candidate with exactly one dependency on the previously published dw.quantities archive and a compiled source-free binary consumer.
contribution.value: Preserve original source ProjectReference and Version, link three original C# files in a temporary packaging project, use the existing NuGet F1 calendar preview and package reader, pin the published dependency and run six independent dual-DLL checks.
debtChanges: Math source project versions and original ProjectReference remain unchanged; only the disposable package projection uses an exact NuGet dependency.
RS138 produces an unreserved, unpublished Expression candidate; its publisher rehearsal, immutable NUGET_LOCAL release and readback remain later explicit gates.
Package-specific notices and third-party rights remain unapproved for public distribution; installed package rollback and other OS platforms are not qualified.
dw.quantities.standard requires both independently published base and Expression packages; never infer that candidate qualification establishes a published dependency.
contribution.nextAction: After RS138 succeeds, inspect the exact Expression candidate/dependency hashes and qualify an isolated no-overwrite publisher rehearsal; only separately authorize private local publication and then qualify the published binary before advancing standard units.
